evidence.observation: Stable column profile with slow upward creep in mid-column temps (T703 78.7->79.6)
Reflux and distillate flows steady (~0.15 / ~0.44 L/h), ratio ~7
Pressure 597-600 mbar and dP steady, no blockage or leak signature
Reboiler reads ~401 °C, implausibly high for this system — likely thermocouple scaling/offset, but stable and not affecting column behavior

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition measurement (GC/analysis) to judge separation; verification of T701 calibration against reboiler duty/setpoint.
